scripts.build: tsc -b packages/sdk packages/common apps/core apps/gateway apps/broker examples/hello-game && npm run build -w @bargames/admin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/sdk packages/common apps/core apps/gateway apps/broker examples/hello-game && npm run typecheck -w @bargames/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n core,gateway,broker,admin,hello -c blue,magenta,yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @bargames/core" "npm run dev -w @bargames/gateway" "npm run dev -w @bargames/broker" "npm run dev -w @bargames/admin" "npm run dev -w hello-game"
